Name: Hojicha's Seaside Interior for Custom Furniture
Author: froststar11
Description:
This mod, in concert with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url], will add almost 150 pieces of furniture to your game! They will be purchasable at Robin's shop, or available through the item catalogue. They do not spawn in with the CJB Item Spawner at this time.

[u]Credits:[/u]

Thanks to Hojicha for letting us convert[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1189] this mod[/url] into a CF content pack! The furniture is beautiful, and I love that I can bring it to people in this format. 

Thanks to Clockworkhound for being amazing and doing this entire conversion for the team working on Project Populate Custom Furniture! 

[u]Installation:[/u]
To use this mod, unzip directly into your StardewValley/Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Unzip directly into your Mods folder. Furniture will be for sale in Robin's shop or available through the catalog.

Manifest.Description: Adds Hojicha's Seaside Interior to the game as a Custom Furniture Content Pack.
